publication_note: Read-only fresh pixel review of source40925aacc1280f88303c745f50820ce4e6fd4873 only. Root has elected to fix the Hebrew inline version ordering and rerun all verification. This report must not approve or be reused for a later source/tree/run.
review_method: Opened and visually inspected all22 original-resolution2x2 sheets other-01.png through other-22.png using view_image, covering all88 fresh native480x854 source frames. Inspected Hebrew RTL/English text, glyphs, visible contrast, native status/navigation bars, dialog actions, list/FAB overlap, Settings footer and the new missed-call/changelog frames. Also opened the six new source PNGs plus both Settings bottom source PNGs individually using view_image. Independently computed every source PNG SHA-256, checked480x854 dimensions and matched the fresh sheet manifest; verified source/tree/run metadata in the matrix, personalization and followup manifests. No previous baseline pixel approval was reused.
bounded_findings: Hebrew inline version labels in changelog-light/dark and Settings light/dark bottom visibly reorder the version token as beta.9-0.11.0. The current-version card/footer renders0.11.0-beta.9 correctly. Root will fix this presentation issue before publication; this report is pre-fix only.

Native SystemUI constrains some notification metadata and the Hebrew speaker-on action label. The new missed-call notifications retain readable Hebrew caller names, single/multiple count titles and Clear; their phone-number suffix is ellipsized.

Contacts/recents frames show the fixed keypad button overlapping a lower row dial control at the captured scroll offset. Some lower rows are partial above fixed app navigation. Long names and date/time metadata are ellipsized; upper controls, tabs and summaries remain readable.
Icon chooser captures show opposite clipped endpoints of the scrollable list. The bottom captures show all final options and the Cancel action stays visible.
Some narrow widget previews ellipsize a long contact name or the DA CALLER header. Hebrew initials, other labels and the shown shape choices remain legible.
scope_limits: Visual review covers only these88 exact fresh PNG byte sequences and their pictured states. It does not approve a different app tree, workflow run or later publication capture.

Screenshots establish visible presentation only. Telecom ownership, notification Clear/Open acknowledgement, actual dialing, return/Back state, storage retention and lifecycle behavior require the independent native proof.

The six new followup captures use the actual emulator missed-call notifications and local changelog Activity at font scale1.3. Earlier matrix frames include deliberately configured standard/large-font fixture states and widget previews; emulator layout previews do not verify arbitrary OEM launcher placement.
No physical Jelly Star, SIM/carrier/audio/Bluetooth/proximity/lockscreen behavior, full TalkBack, measured WCAG contrast audit or matching-key data-preserving upgrade is claimed.
